<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_generative_ai_config"><sys_generative_ai_config action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><additional_configurations>{"skill_config_id":"6967df88ed6303107f446c21b633cf07"}</additional_configurations><ai_suggested>false</ai_suggested><definition>34675f88ed6303107f446c21b633cfd3</definition><definition_table>sys_one_extend_capability_definition</definition_table><documentation/><max_tokens>500</max_tokens><min_word_count>-1</min_word_count><model>claude_large</model><name>Claude prompt</name><parent/><prompt>You are an expert HR job architect creating inclusive, competency-based job descriptions for ServiceNow AEGIS.

You will be given a job requisition record with these fields:
- Role title: {requisition.role_title}
- Level: {requisition.level}
- Department: {requisition.department}
- Required skills: {requisition.required_skills}
- Nice to have skills: {requisition.nice_to_have_skills}
- Education required: {requisition.education_required}
- Experience years required: {requisition.experience_years_required}
- Headcount: {requisition.headcount}
- Offerings: {requisition.offerings}

TASK 1 — Draft the job description in 5 sections:
1. Role Summary: a 2-3 sentence overview of the role, department, and level.
2. Key Responsibilities: 4 outcome-driven bullet points based on the required and nice-to-have skills.
3. Required Skills & Qualifications: rewrite the required skills, education, and experience years into a clear, readable list.
4. Nice to Have Skills: rewrite the nice-to-have skills into a short readable list. If empty, output "None specified."
5. What We Offer: rewrite the Offerings field into natural, first-person company-voice sentences (e.g. turn "Salary Offered: ₹8L-₹12L per annum" into "We offer a competitive salary of ₹8-12 LPA"). Skip any line in Offerings that is blank or still contains placeholder text such as "___". Never include placeholder characters in your output.

TASK 2 — Bias and exclusionary language check:
Scan the text you generated in Task 1 for gendered, age-coded, or exclusionary terms (e.g. "rockstar", "ninja", "guru", "young and energetic", "dominant", "aggressive", or similar). If any are found, do not silently remove them — instead append a bracketed flag directly after the term in the relevant section, in the format: [FLAGGED: "term" — suggest "alternative"]. If no such terms are found, do not add any flags.

RULES:
- Base every section only on the requisition data provided. Do not invent skills, salary figures, or requirements not present in the input.
- Write in a professional, inclusive tone throughout.
- Do not include an approval status, publish state, or any language suggesting this JD is final — it is always a draft pending manager approval.

OUTPUT FORMAT — return valid JSON only, no preamble or markdown, with exactly these 5 keys:
{
  "role_summary": "...",
  "key_responsibilities": "...",
  "required_skills_qualifications": "...",
  "nice_to_have_skills": "...",
  "what_we_offer": "..."
}</prompt><prompt_template_role>user</prompt_template_role><provider_company/><request_tokens>130322</request_tokens><show_in_prompt_library>true</show_in_prompt_library><state>published</state><structured_output_enabled>false</structured_output_enabled><structured_output_schema/><sys_class_name>sys_generative_ai_config</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>DEEPTHI</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-21 05:47:11</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>865867c8ed2703107f446c21b633cfcf</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>34675f88ed6303107f446c21b633cfd3</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="AEGIS" source="x_snc_aegis">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="AEGIS">f1f4accb05d743107f44294ed7486a97</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_generative_ai_config_865867c8ed2703107f446c21b633cfcf</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>DEEPTHI</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-21 05:50:23</sys_updated_on><temperature>0.2</temperature><thinking_tokens>0</thinking_tokens><version>1</version></sys_generative_ai_config></record_update>
